```{r prep-sem}
#| dependson: load-scores

prep_sem <- \(scores, tasks) {
  scores |>
    filter(item_task %in% tasks) |>
    arrange(user_id, item_task, age) |>
    slice(1, .by = c(user_id, item_task)) |>
    select(site_label, user_id, item_task, score, age) |>
    mutate(age = min(age), .by = c(site_label, user_id)) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = item_task, values_from = score) |>
    mutate(across(all_of(tasks), \(x) scale(x)[,1]))
}

# wide_scores <- prep_sem(included_scores, unique(included_scores$item_task))
wide_scores <- prep_sem(coretask_scores, unique(coretask_scores$item_task))
```

```{r sem-g}
#| dependson: prep-sem

model_cov_no_age <- "
  # first-order factors
  reasoning =~ matrix + mrot
  ef        =~ hf + mg + sds
  language  =~ trog + vocab

  # covariances of factors with observed outcomes
  reasoning ~~ math + tom
  ef        ~~ math + tom
  language  ~~ math + tom

  # allow math and tom to covary
  math ~~ tom
"

fit_cov_no_age <- sem(
  model_cov_no_age, data = wide_scores,
  estimator = 'MLR', std.lv = TRUE, missing = 'fiml'
)
# summary(fit_cov_no_age, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

```{r sem-g-age}
#| dependson: prep-sem

# wide_scores$log_age_c <- scale(log(wide_scores$age))[,1] # removing log_age_c following feedback from BD and NR.
wide_scores$age_c <- scale(wide_scores$age, scale = FALSE)[, 1] # center age

model_cov_age <- "
  # first-order factors (fix first loading to 1 for each factor)
  reasoning =~ 1*matrix + mrot
  ef        =~ 1*hf     + mg + sds
  language  =~ 1*trog   + vocab

  # age predicts factors
  reasoning ~ age_c
  ef        ~ age_c
  language  ~ age_c

  # age predicts outcomes
  math ~ age_c
  tom  ~ age_c

  # covariances of factors with observed outcomes
  reasoning ~~ math + tom
  ef        ~~ math + tom
  language  ~~ math + tom

  # (recommended) residual covariance between outcomes
  math ~~ tom
"

fit_cov_age <- sem(
  model_cov_age, data = wide_scores,
  estimator = 'MLR', missing = 'fiml',
  std.lv = FALSE, optim.method = 'nlminb',
  control = list(iter.max = 50000, rel.tol = 1e-6)
)
# summary(fit_cov_age, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

```{r sem-g-plot}
source("sem/modified_sem_plot.R") # veronica helper

pe <- parameterEstimates(fit_cov_age, standardized = TRUE)
latents  <- sort(unique(pe$lhs[pe$op == "=~"]))
indics   <- sort(unique(pe$rhs[pe$op == "=~"]))
extras   <- c("age_c","math","tom")
observed <- sort(union(indics, extras))

nodes <- tibble(
  name  = c(observed, latents),
  shape = c(rep("rect", length(observed)), rep("oval", length(latents)))
)

# Pretty labels
nodes$label <- recode(
  nodes$name,
  matrix    = "Pattern\nMatching",
  mrot      = "Shape\nRotation",
  hf        = "Hearts and\nFlowers",
  mg        = "Memory",
  sds       = "Same and\nDifferent",
  trog      = "Sentence\nUnderstanding",
  tom       = "Stories",
  ef        = "Executive\nFunction",
  age_c     = "Age (years)",
  .default  = str_to_title(nodes$name)
)

factor_names  <- c("reasoning","ef","language")
outcome_names <- c("math","tom")

edges <- pe %>%
  filter(op %in% c("~","=~","~~")) %>% # hide math and tom residual covariance
  filter(!(op == "~~" & ((lhs == "math" & rhs == "tom") |
                                (lhs == "tom"  & rhs == "math")))) %>%
  mutate(keep = case_when(
    op %in% c("~","=~") ~ TRUE,
    op == "~~" & lhs %in% factor_names & rhs %in% outcome_names ~ TRUE,
    op == "~~" & rhs %in% factor_names & lhs %in% outcome_names ~ TRUE,
    op == "~~" & lhs %in% factor_names & rhs %in% factor_names & lhs != rhs ~ TRUE,
    op == "~~" & lhs == rhs ~ TRUE,
    TRUE ~ FALSE
  )) %>%
  filter(keep) %>%
  transmute(
    from = if_else(op == "~", rhs, lhs),
    to   = if_else(op == "~", lhs, rhs),
    op, est, std.all, pvalue,
    arrow     = if_else(op == "~~", "both", "last"),
    curved    = op == "~~" & lhs != rhs,
    curvature = case_when(
      op == "~~" & lhs != rhs & lhs %in% factor_names & rhs %in% factor_names ~ 0.20,
      op == "~~" & lhs != rhs ~ 0.35,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(NA)
    ),
    linetype  = if_else(op == "~~" & lhs != rhs, 2L, 1L)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stars = case_when(pvalue < .001 ~ "***",
                             pvalue < .01  ~ "**",
                             pvalue < .05  ~ "*",
                             TRUE ~ ""),
    label = sprintf("%.2f%s", std.all, stars)
  )

layout_ids <- as.matrix(read_excel("sem/layouts/SEM_layout.xlsx", col_names = FALSE))
layout_ids[layout_ids == ""] <- NA

# checks
in_layout <- na.omit(unique(c(layout_ids)))
stopifnot(setequal(in_layout, nodes$name))   
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(in_layout)))

g <- tidySEM::prepare_graph(
  edges = edges,
  nodes = nodes,
  layout = t(layout_ids),
  text_size = 3.6,
  rect_width = 7, rect_height = 3.5,
  ellipses_width = 6, ellipses_height = 3.5,
  variance_height = 2.5, variance_width = 2,
  arrow_angle = 15, arrow_length = .2,
  var_arrow_angle = 15, var_arrow_length = .1,
  spacing_y = 5, spacing_x = 7,
  fix_coord = FALSE
)

# colors
g$nodes$fill <- case_when(
  g$nodes$shape == "oval"      ~ "#E8F2FF",
  g$nodes$name  == "age_c" ~ "#FFF2E0",
  TRUE                         ~ "#F5F5F5"
)
g$nodes$colour <- "#1F1F1F"
g$nodes$font   <- "#1F1F1F"

# edge colors
g$edges$colour <- case_when(
  g$edges$op == "=~" ~ "#1B9E77",
  g$edges$op == "~"  ~ "#386CB0",
  g$edges$op == "~~" ~ "#6B6B6B",
  TRUE               ~ "#000000"
)
g$edges$linetype[g$edges$op == "~~"] <- 2L
g$edges$linetype[g$edges$op != "~~"] <- 1L
g$edges$size <- 0.6

# labels
g$nodes$geom_text <- TRUE
g$edges$label_fill   <- "white"
g$edges$label_colour <- "#1F1F1F"
g$edges$label_alpha  <- 1
```

```{r sem-factors}
# single factor model 
mdl_1f <- "
g =~ matrix + mrot + hf + mg + sds + trog + vocab + math + tom
g ~ age_c
"

mdl_2f <- "
reasoning =~ mg + sds + hf + mrot + matrix + math
language  =~ vocab + trog + tom
reasoning ~~ language
reasoning ~ age_c
language  ~ age_c
"

mdl_3f <- "
reasoning =~ mrot + matrix + math
ef        =~ mg + sds + hf
language  =~ vocab + trog + tom
reasoning ~~ ef + language
ef ~~ language
reasoning ~ age_c
ef ~ age_c
language ~ age_c
"

fit_1f <- sem(mdl_1f, data = wide_scores,
              estimator = "MLR", missing = "fiml", std.lv = TRUE, optim.method = "nlminb",
              control = list(iter.max = 50000, rel.tol = 1e-6))
fit_2f <- sem(mdl_2f, data = wide_scores,
              estimator = "MLR", missing = "fiml", std.lv = TRUE, optim.method = "nlminb",
              control = list(iter.max = 50000, rel.tol = 1e-6))
fit_3f <- sem(mdl_3f, data = wide_scores,
              estimator = "MLR", missing = "fiml", std.lv = TRUE, optim.method = "nlminb",
              control = list(iter.max = 50000, rel.tol = 1e-6))

want <- c("chisq", "pvalue", "tli", "cfi", "rmsea")

grab_fit <- function(fit, name){
  fm <- fitMeasures(fit, fit.measures = want)
  tibble(
    Model  = name,
    `Chi-square` = unname(fm["chisq"]),
    `p-value`    = unname(fm["pvalue"]),
    TLI          = unname(fm["tli"]),
    CFI          = unname(fm["cfi"]),
    RMSEA        = unname(fm["rmsea"])
  )
}

fit_tbl <- bind_rows(
  grab_fit(fit_1f, "Single factor + age"),
  grab_fit(fit_2f, "Two factors + age"),
  grab_fit(fit_3f, "Three factors + age")
)
```

# edges from standardized parameter estimates ---
pe_ef <- parameterEstimates(fit_ef, standardized = TRUE)

edges <- pe_ef |>
  filter(op %in% c("~","=~","~~")) |>
  transmute(
    lhs, rhs, op,
    from = if_else(op == "~", rhs, lhs),
    to   = if_else(op == "~", lhs, rhs),
    std.all, pvalue,
    arrow = case_when(
      op == "~~" & lhs == rhs ~ "both",  # variance loop
      op == "~~" & lhs != rhs ~ "none",  # covariance
      TRUE ~ "last"                       # regressions/loadings
    ),
    curvature = if_else(op == "~~" & lhs != rhs, 50, NA_real_),
    linetype  = if_else(op == "~~" & lhs != rhs, 2, 1),
    label = case_when(
      op %in% c("~","=~") ~ sprintf("%.2f%s", std.all,
        case_when(pvalue < .001 ~ "***",
                         pvalue < .01  ~ "**",
                         pvalue < .05  ~ "*", TRUE ~ "")),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", std.all)
    )
  )
